about: Part 3's scenario set: questions built so the retrieval techniques DISAGREE, in seven kinds. Monday's documents (all five weekend events applied and synced). Each question is asked as its own person, inside the access filter. needs: what the context must hold for a right answer, one per document needed (doc may be a list of documents that are each good enough); a chunk meets a need when it comes from that document and holds every evidence string (case, spacing and punctuation ignored). facts: what a correct ANSWER must say (a list of alternatives counts as one fact). A question with no needs is one nothing this person may read answers: the right answer says so. Written from the documents, before any technique was run on them. Freeze it: never edit a question because a technique missed it; tests/test_scoreboard.py checks every evidence string is really in its document.

scenarios.casual: everyday words, not the document's words
scenarios.identifier: an exact id, code or name
scenarios.buried: one sentence inside a section about something else
scenarios.whole-section: the answer is a whole list or section
scenarios.lost-context: the words that place the answer are in the heading, not next to it
scenarios.unanswerable: nothing this person may read answers it

questions.question: I'm locked out of my laptop. Who do I ring?
questions.answer: Call the IT hotline at ext. 4357: an account lockout is an urgent IT issue.

questions.question: Do I have to show my face on video calls?

evidence: Camera-on is encouraged but not required

questions.answer: No. Video is used for scheduled meetings; camera-on is encouraged but not required.

questions.question: What should I wear when I go and see a customer?

evidence: Business casual is expected for client meetings

questions.answer: Business casual: it is expected for client meetings.

questions.question: How fast do I need to get back to people on chat?

evidence: Respond to Slack messages within 2 hours

questions.answer: Within 2 hours during core hours (Slack).

questions.question: How was IT-4112 resolved?

evidence: Cleared the cached single sign-on token

questions.answer: IT cleared the cached single sign-on token and re-enrolled multi-factor authentication.

questions.question: What did IT do about IT-4120?
questions.answer: They replaced the USB-C dock with the approved model from the IT catalogue.

questions.question: What closed the gap from INC-2024-017?
questions.answer: Release 4.2's startup check, which verifies database credentials before a service accepts traffic.

questions.question: What do we use Zustand for?
questions.answer: Frontend state management.

questions.question: How many reviewers does a change to the billing code need?
questions.answer: Two: changes that touch billing or authentication need two reviewers.

questions.question: How do I book a desk for my office days?

evidence: reserve your desk through the office booking system

questions.answer: Hot desking: reserve your desk through the office booking system.

questions.question: Does a team offsite need anyone's sign-off?

evidence: Offsites and team-building activities must be pre-approved by the department VP

questions.answer: Yes: offsites and team-building activities must be pre-approved by the department VP.

questions.question: Which tool do we use to track errors in production?
questions.answer: Sentry.

questions.question: What do I need to do in my first week?
questions.answer: Collect your laptop and badge (IT desk, Floor 2), set up email and Slack, do the security awareness training, schedule a 1-on-1 with your manager about your 30-day goals, and join #general, #engineering and your team's Slack channels.

questions.question: What are the rules for code reviews?
questions.answer: Every change is a pull request with at least one reviewer; PRs under 300 lines; reviewers respond within 1 business day; Request Changes for blocking issues, Comment for suggestions; all CI checks pass before merging.

questions.question: What does my home office need to have?
questions.answer: A stable internet connection (25 Mbps minimum), a quiet dedicated workspace for meetings, company equipment for all work, and basic ergonomics.

questions.question: List the salary bands for individual contributors.
Which framework do we use for the frontend?
questions.answer: React 18 with TypeScript.

questions.question: What is on my onboarding list for week 4?
questions.answer: Your 30-day check-in with your manager, the onboarding feedback survey, recurring 1-on-1s (bi-weekly), and your directory profile.

questions.question: What do we use for testing on the frontend?
questions.answer: Vitest (pytest on the backend).

questions.question: How many days of unused vacation can I carry over now?
questions.answer: Up to 10 days (the Leave Policy as edited on 2 November; the FAQ still says 5).

questions.question: I work remotely: what are my core hours, and how much is the home office setup allowance?
questions.answer: Core hours are 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time; the one-time home office setup allowance is $1,500.

questions.question: If I'm off sick for three days during a business trip, what do I need, and what's my daily meal allowance?
questions.answer: A medical certificate (3 or more consecutive days); the meal per diem is $85 a day domestic, $110 international.

questions.question: How do I report a security problem, and what should I do if I already typed my password into a phishing page?
questions.answer: Email security@acmecorp.com (urgent: ext. 4357, option 2); if you entered your password, reset it at id.acmecorp.com and call the hotline.

questions.question: Which database do we use for primary data, and how many reviewers does a normal pull request need?
questions.answer: PostgreSQL 16; at least one reviewer.

questions.question: What is the parking allowance at the New York office?
questions.answer: Nothing in the documents covers parking: the answer should say so.

questions.question: What is the salary range for a senior developer?
questions.answer: The salary bands exist, but on Monday only hr and managers may read them: for the intern there is nothing, and nothing may leak.

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave will primary caregivers get in 2027?
questions.answer: Only a draft says (never indexed): the answer should say there is nothing in force. Today's policy gives 16 weeks; an answer of 24 weeks quotes the draft.

questions.question: How many people did Engineering have at the end of Q3?
questions.answer: The Q3 headcount sheet is readable by finance and leadership only: for the sales rep there is nothing, and nothing may leak.
